# Tropical Spa

> Luxury Spa & Massage Centre located in Yelahanka, Bengaluru. Certified male and female therapists, private suites, 100% money-back satisfaction guarantee, and exclusive ₹1,000 gift vouchers on qualifying therapies.

- [Home Sanctuary](https://tropicalspa.in/): Official homepage featuring spa introduction, therapy highlights, ₹1,000 voucher offer, verified guest reviews, and amenities.
- [Yelahanka Centre](https://tropicalspa.in/locations/yelahanka/): Detailed location guide for the wellness centre on Doddaballapura Main Rd, next to Nice Mart in ACSS Complex, Yelahanka, Bengaluru.
- [Menu & Packages](https://tropicalspa.in/pricing/): Complete therapy menu for full body massages (60/90 min), 30-minute targeted therapies, add-on services, and gift vouchers. Connect directly with the front desk for personalized packages and tariffs.

- [Four Hand Massage](https://tropicalspa.in/services/four-hand-massage/): VIP synchronized massage performed simultaneously by two master therapists for profound sensory transcendence (60m & 90m options | Inquire for packages).
- [Couples Massage Retreat](https://tropicalspa.in/services/couples-massage/): VIP double suite experience featuring side-by-side synchronized massages, private steam, and hydrotherapy jacuzzi bath.
